basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I'm a 31-year-old software engineer who loves exploring game mechanics and diving into the technical aspects of gaming. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy reading about control theory and the latest in tech. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and sometimes during lunch breaks. I'm single and enjoy hanging out with friends online over the weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in computer science and work as a software engineer, which gives me a strong foundation in technology and gaming. My interest in control theory comes from a project I worked on in university, and I've continued to self-study the topic. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught through years of playing and engaging with online communities.
